# Export access is now limited to authorized project members.

Export access is now limited to authorized project members. Existing behavior changes in this release; review the required action before upgrading.

## Highlights

- Export access is now limited to authorized project members.
- Teams can review completed exports from the new history view.

## Action required

- Grant the export permission to service accounts that run exports.

SemVerge 4.0.0 is available now.
